defects.justification: The HttpClient is built with newHttpClient() (no connect timeout) and neither the token exchange (line 172) nor the /user fetch (line 186) sets a request timeout, so a slow or hung GitHub endpoint pins Javalin request threads indefinitely during /callback.

safeNext rejects '//', backslash, CR and LF but not tab; a next value like '/\t/evil.com' passes and is sent in Location, and browsers strip ASCII tab while parsing URLs, turning it into the protocol-relative '//evil.com' and redirecting off-site after login.

exchangeCode never checks the token endpoint's HTTP status and parses whatever body arrives with readTree; a non-JSON error page throws a parse exception and the full response body is embedded in the exception logged to stderr, instead of a checked status with a clear error.
